verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's docs show it can autonomously edit code, compile, run tests, and present a diff for human review (byteask-docs-1, byteask-docs-18), and it supports headless/CI execution via `exec` (byteask-docs-4, byteask-docs-19, byteask-docs-20) — covering 'build, test, and present for review.' However, ByteAsk is explicitly a local terminal-based agent (TUI/CLI) rather than a cloud-hosted background agent, and there is no evidence of a 'demo' capability (e.g., live walkthrough or preview) beyond the diff artifact. Missing for 10: evidence of cloud/remote hosted execution (as opposed to local terminal runs), and any feature demo/presentation capability beyond a code diff.
